analysis.note: SCREEN VARIANT B -- variant A's analysis card unchanged (`tran 10u 3m`, no `uic`, EN a DC level); the ONLY difference from variant A is the `.ic` card in the netlist body, which is why the two netlist snapshots differ only in that line and in the `sch_path` comment. `.ic` (not `.nodeset`) is deliberate: it constrains the `.op` rather than merely hinting it.

measurements.name: vout_ss
measurements.note: Steady-state VOUT averaged over the settled tail (2.5ms-3ms of a 3ms transient), identical card and identical ratified window (spec/target-spec.md "Output", 1.8V +-2%, ratified by issue #1 / DR-006) to the one sim/mc-output-accuracy uses -- kept identical so this screen variant's tally is comparable with that bench's records. This slug substantiates no spec row; see the experiment claim.
measurements.spice: .meas tran vout_ss avg v(vout) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: fb_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.fb), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the divider tap the error amp compares against VREF -- the node whose 668-1984 V (and 1.3e15 V) settled values are the whole finding: FB is fed ONLY by VOUT through a passive three-leg res_xhigh_po string, so any realizable state has 0 <= V(N_FBB) <= V(FB) <= V(VOUT) <= VIN.
measurements.spice: .meas tran fb_ss avg v(xldo.fb) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: n_fbb_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.n_fbb), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the divider's lower tap -- second half of the same algebra check.
measurements.spice: .meas tran n_fbb_ss avg v(xldo.n_fbb) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ea_out_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ea_out), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the error amp's output, i.e. the pass device's gate: #164 Scope item 1 asked what holds it low enough to keep the pass device fully on.
measurements.spice: .meas tran ea_out_ss avg v(xldo.ea_out) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ea_cz_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ea_cz), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the Miller/compensation node (R_CZ's far end) -- one of the three res_xhigh_po instances ngspice names in its singular-matrix warnings.
measurements.spice: .meas tran ea_cz_ss avg v(xldo.ea_cz) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ss_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ss), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: soft-start ramp node -- shows whether soft-start is still holding the loop down (Scope item 1 candidate 1).
measurements.spice: .meas tran ss_ss avg v(xldo.ss) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ts_cmp_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ts_cmp), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: thermal-shutdown comparator output -- shows whether thermal shutdown has tripped (Scope item 1 candidate 2).
measurements.spice: .meas tran ts_cmp_ss avg v(xldo.ts_cmp) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: cl_cmp_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.cl_cmp), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: current-limit comparator output -- shows whether current limit is the holder (Scope item 1 candidate 3).
measurements.spice: .meas tran cl_cmp_ss avg v(xldo.cl_cmp) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: amp_enn_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.amp_enn), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the amp's enable-gated tail return -- shows whether the enable path is holding the amp off (Scope item 1 candidate 4).
measurements.spice: .meas tran amp_enn_ss avg v(xldo.amp_enn) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ea_d1_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ea_d1), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: error-amp input-stage drain 1 -- with EA_D2, shows whether the input stage is inverted (Scope item 1 candidate 5) and, if so, that FB drives it rather than the reverse.
measurements.spice: .meas tran ea_d1_ss avg v(xldo.ea_d1) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ea_d2_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ea_d2), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: error-amp input-stage drain 2 -- see EA_D1.
measurements.spice: .meas tran ea_d2_ss avg v(xldo.ea_d2) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: ea_tail_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.ea_tail), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: error-amp tail node -- whether the input pair has headroom at all.
measurements.spice: .meas tran ea_tail_ss avg v(xldo.ea_tail) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: biasp_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.biasp), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the PMOS bias rail feeding every tail in the block -- whether the bias generator itself is where the solve went wrong.
measurements.spice: .meas tran biasp_ss avg v(xldo.biasp) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: nb_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.nb), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: the NMOS bias node (the bias string's own tap).
measurements.spice: .meas tran nb_ss avg v(xldo.nb) from=2.5m to=3m

measurements.name: cl_sns_ss
measurements.note: Node dump (unbounded -- diagnostic, no limit and therefore no verdict): settled V(xldo.cl_sns), averaged over the same tail as vout_ss. Why this node: current-limit sense node -- the sense leg's own state, distinct from the comparator output above.
measurements.spice: .meas tran cl_sns_ss avg v(xldo.cl_sns) from=2.5m to=3m
